# Prime Fleet Care

> Prime Fleet Care is Perth, Western Australia's specialist mobile truck wash, fleet wash and fleet detailing service. We come to your depot, wash and detail on your fleet's schedule, bund the wash zone and recollect all dirty water, and use eco-friendly products - keeping trucks road-ready with zero downtime and no wash bay required. Fully insured (public liability cover).

## Why fleet operators choose Prime Fleet Care
- Fully mobile - we bring water tanks, pressure washers and all equipment to your yard. You never move a truck or need a wash bay.
- Works around your fleet's schedule - early-morning starts, late-night finishes and weekends, so washing never disrupts your runs.
- Bunded and compliant - we set up water bunding around the wash zone, capture all washwater, and dispose of it responsibly off site. Zero stormwater runoff, no environmental compliance risk for your depot.
- Eco-friendly products - biodegradable cleaning chemicals that are tough on diesel soot, grease and road grime but safe for the environment.
- Fully insured - public liability cover on every job.
- Reliable and consistent - operators consistently rate us 5/5 for showing up on time and delivering clean trucks every single visit.

## Services (mobile truck wash and fleet detailing, on-site)
- Exterior truck wash (cab, body, trailer)
- Full exterior truck and fleet detailing
- Ceramic coating / paint sealant for long-term protection
- Engine and radiator degreasing
- Underbody / undercarriage cleaning
- Interior cab cleaning, vacuuming and full cab detailing
- Trailer interior wash
- Recurring weekly, fortnightly and monthly fleet wash and detailing programs (fleet pricing for 10+ vehicles)

## Vehicles serviced
Semi-trailers, prime movers, rigid trucks, tippers, tankers, refrigerated vans, utes and light commercial vehicles - single trucks through to entire fleets.

## Service area
Perth metropolitan area - including Fremantle, Kwinana, Rockingham, Mandurah, Joondalup, Midland, Malaga, Welshpool, Kewdale, Forrestfield, Kenwick, Canning Vale, Osborne Park and Wangara - plus regional WA (Kalgoorlie, Bunbury, Geraldton) on request.
